name: Festival de Cannes 2027
job: Help visitors evaluate unconfirmed accreditation routes, build a personal screening itinerary with transfer buffers, and plan realistic costs without implying access or booking availability.
facets: Visitor-entered screening clashes and transfer buffers
Professional and cinephile access evidence tracking
Editable per-person travel and accommodation costs
source_notes: The official Festival de Cannes website lists 11–22 May 2027. Accreditation and ticketing pages contain 2026 edition deadlines and rules; do not assume that they apply in 2027. Screening programmes and individual availability are unverified.
